E2 suggests lattice distortion restricts screw dislocation mobility, and only mentions thermal activation overcoming barriers, not a lowered Peierls barrier. Neither passage supports the proposed mechanism of enhanced dislocation nucleation, mobility, or ductile fracture due to lattice distortion.
